games.against: The 49ers remain a strong team and the model does not directly price scheme/team strength.

games.evidence: SportsLine publicly backs NYG +2.5. DraftKings was ARI -1 while Action was ARI -2.5, so Sly is valuable versus DK but market-equal versus Action.
